milestones.title: The archive started small
milestones.summary: The first formal archive import tracked 40 bots (36 public and 4 unlisted) and started keeping bot-history snapshots instead of only a current list.
milestones.totalLabel: bots in the first formal import

milestones.title: Early history was reconstructed
milestones.summary: Five older snapshots were rebuilt — 18 → 23 → 31 → 37 → 40 bots — with first-seen dates and milestone history.

milestones.title: Deleted-bot preservation became a real archive feature
milestones.summary: A dedicated archived-bot view began preserving the last known version of bots that disappeared instead of dropping them from the collection.
